articles.title: Microsoft’s Clippy-like Mico character is no longer the face of Copilot
articles.description: Microsoft Copilot will no longer show its emotive yellow blob, Mico, when you use the chatbot's voice mode. In a support page, Microsoft says it's going to move Mico to its Learn Live platform, where the avatar will have "more to react to," as reported earlier by GeekWire. Mico launched in Copilot's voice mode last […]

items.title: Microsoft’s Clippy-like Mico character is no longer the face of Copilot
items.summary: 微软Copilot语音模式将不再显示黄色虚拟形象Mico，该角色将被移至Learn Live平台继续使用。
items.why_it_matters: 这反映出微软正在调整其AI产品的交互策略，可能转向更实用的功能导向。

items.title: Suno is trying to look more like a real music production tool
items.summary: Suno发布Studio 2.0版本，新增用户呼声最高的MIDI支持，向专业数字音频工作站方向升级。
items.why_it_matters: 这表明AI音乐生成工具正通过兼容行业标准格式来吸引专业音乐制作人。

items.title: I looked inside an AI generated movie, and the best parts were all human
items.summary: 有评论指出，一部由AI参与生成的电影中，表现最佳的内容实际上均来自人类创作者。
items.why_it_matters: 这显示当前AI生成技术在影视创作中仍难以独立呈现高质量内容，或影响行业对AI制作能力的判断。

items.title: Does Google even want to win at AI?
items.summary: 谷歌上周宣布对人工智能部门Google DeepMind进行重大重组，引发外界对其AI竞争力的讨论。
items.why_it_matters: 这反映出大型科技公司内部AI战略与组织架构正在经历深度调整，或将影响后续研发方向。
